comment: Independent muse.c use_offensive() witness: a hurled potion whose announcement stops at --More-- still lands. A burdened debug Valkyrie wearing a ring of searching drops a potion of paralysis beside a hill orc, which picks it up. While she applies a tin whistle, "You produce a high whistling sound." leaves no room for "The hill orc hurls a sky blue potion!", so tty asks for --More-- before mthrowu.c m_throw() flies it. The vapours paralyse her, and allmain.c moveloop_core() skips that turn's automatic search because gm.multi < 0. The elapsed-turn planning clone used to skip the flight at that --More--, expected the search, and stopped the segment with "elapsed-turn preflight disagreed with live search".
